900100.title: The Narrator's Confession

structure.pattern: The teller admits the tale was shaped; the reader rebuilds the story.

900100.description:
The voice was lying: the narrator twist. The narrator's confession reveals the voice was lying: the trusted teller admits the tale was shaped, shaded, or stolen. The craft is the planted unreliability — the small contradictions the reader forgives, until the confession reframes them.

The twist's power is the reread: the whole story changes in retrospect, and the reader must revisit every scene.

The twist's fairness is the trail: the lies must be visible in hindsight. The narrator confesses; the reader reconstructs.

demo.title: Interactive record tour - The Narrator's Confession

900101.title: The Villain's Mercy

structure.pattern: The monster spares the hero; the reason reframes the villain.

900101.description:
The monster spares: the mercy twist. The villain's mercy breaks the pattern: the monster, with the hero helpless, chooses to spare. The craft is the motive's reveal — the mercy must have a reason the reader didn't see.

The twist's shock is the inversion: the expected cruelty becomes the unexpected grace.

The twist's depth is the question: the spared hero must live with the debt. The villain shows mercy; the story gains a shadow.

demo.title: Interactive record tour - The Villain's Mercy

900102.title: The Hero's Refusal

structure.pattern: The hero declines the call; the plot finds another way.

900102.description:
The call, declined: the refusal twist. The hero's refusal declines the call: the chosen one says no, and the story must find another way. The craft is the consequence — the refusal must cost, and the cost must be shown.

The twist's freshness is the subversion: the genre expects the yes, and the no rewrites the plot.

The twist's arc is the return: the refuser often comes back, changed. The hero refuses; the story adapts.

demo.title: Interactive record tour - The Hero's Refusal

900103.title: The Witness's Silence

structure.pattern: The witness finally speaks; the withheld truth reshapes the past.

900103.description:
The one who saw, says nothing: the silence twist. The witness's silence hides the seer: the one who saw everything says nothing, and the story orbits the absence. The craft is the silence's weight — the reader must feel the withheld truth pressing on every scene.

The twist's reveal is the reason: the silence was protection, or guilt, or love.

The twist's ache is the cost: the silence shaped every life it touched. The witness speaks at last; the past rearranges.

demo.title: Interactive record tour - The Witness's Silence

900104.title: The Map's Secret

structure.pattern: The chart was drawn to mislead; the true map replays the journey.

900104.description:
The map was the message: the cartography twist. The map's secret reveals the map was the message: the chart the heroes followed was drawn to mislead — or to guide the worthy. The craft is the map's centrality: the reader must have studied it, trusted it, navigated by it.

The twist's delight is the re-navigation: the journey replays with the true map.

The twist's maker is the question: who drew the false chart, and why. The map lied; the territory tells.

demo.title: Interactive record tour - The Map's Secret

900105.title: The Heir's Lie

structure.pattern: The bloodline is fiction; the legitimacy collapses.

900105.description:
The bloodline was fiction: the heir twist. The heir's lie unmakes the bloodline: the throne's claimant is no kin at all, and the legitimacy was the fiction. The craft is the paper trail — the documents, the witnesses, the history, all pointing the wrong way.

The twist's stakes are the kingdom: the lie supported the peace, and the truth threatens it.

The twist's tragedy is the believer: the heir who thought the lie was true. The bloodline breaks; the crown trembles.

demo.title: Interactive record tour - The Heir's Lie

900106.title: The Cure's Price

structure.pattern: The cure demands a hidden price; the healed never agreed.

900106.description:
The healing costs: the cure twist. The cure's price reveals the healing costs: the remedy works, but the payment is the twist — the memory, the years, the love. The craft is the price's hiding: the reader must not see the cost until the cure is taken.

The twist's horror is the consent: the healed never agreed to the price.

The twist's question is the worth: was the cure worth the cost. The cure works; the bill arrives.

demo.title: Interactive record tour - The Cure's Price

900107.title: The Prophecy's Trap

structure.pattern: Fulfilling the prophecy was the trap all along.

900107.description:
The foretelling was the snare: the prophecy twist. The prophecy's trap springs the foretelling: the prophecy was not a warning but a snare, and fulfilling it was the trap. The craft is the self-fulfilling: the hero's efforts to avoid the fate cause it.

The twist's irony is the agency: the prophecy needed the hero's resistance to work.

The twist's escape is the refusal: the only win is not to play. The prophecy traps; the wise decline.

demo.title: Interactive record tour - The Prophecy's Trap

900108.title: The Ally's Betrayal

structure.pattern: The trusted friend was the enemy's instrument.

900108.description:
The friend was the foe: the betrayal twist. The ally's betrayal unmasks the friend: the trusted companion was the enemy's instrument all along. The craft is the loyalty's performance — the betrayal must be visible in hindsight, in the small saved moments.

The twist's wound is the intimacy: the closer the ally, the deeper the cut.

The twist's aftermath is the doubt: the hero trusts no one, and the story chills. The ally turns; the fellowship fractures.

demo.title: Interactive record tour - The Ally's Betrayal

900109.title: The Twistwright's Oath

structure.pattern: The ethics of surprise: earned, purposeful, restrained.

900109.description:
The capstone: the ethics of the twist. The twistwright's oath is the capstone: the ethics of the surprise. The oath's clauses are the fairness (the twist must be earned), the purpose (the twist must serve the story), and the restraint (the twist must not be the story).

The oath's practice is the reread test: the twist should deepen the reread, not excuse the first read.

The oath's reward is the trust: the reader who trusts the twistwright surrenders to the story. The oath binds the writer; the twist earns the gasp.

demo.title: Interactive record tour - The Twistwright's Oath
